annotations.title: Check if a user has a permission level on a content (class, course, event, exam, integration, organization, Quiz set, SCORM learning material, tag or video)

description: Check if a user has a permission level on a content (class, course, event, exam, integration, organization, Quiz set, SCORM learning material, tag or video). Returns whether the user has the permission, and whether there is a permission rule with exactly these parameters.

content.description: identification string of the content (e.g. the exam identification string if type is exam)

permission.description: permission level (view / report / control / modify / grant / admin), finances is only available for events

type.description: type of the content (scorm: SCORM learning material, quiz: Quiz set)

name: edubase_get_content_permission
